instruction: Please create a new group named "developers" and create a user named "dave" with password "Dev@Pass456" who is a member of the developers group.

result.command: USERNAME="dave"; GROUPNAME="developers"; (getent group "$GROUPNAME" &>/dev/null && echo 'Group exists: YES') || echo 'Group exists: NO'; (id "$USERNAME" &>/dev/null && echo 'User exists: YES') || echo 'User exists: NO'; (id -nG "$USERNAME" 2>/dev/null | grep -q "$GROUPNAME" && echo 'User in group: YES') || echo 'User in group: NO'; (sudo grep "^$USERNAME:" /etc/shadow | grep -q -v '!' && sudo grep "^$USERNAME:" /etc/shadow | grep -q -v '*' && echo 'Password set: YES') || echo 'Password set: NO'

metadata.explanation: Task requires creating group 'developers' and user 'dave' with password 'Dev@Pass456' and membership in that group. Evaluator comprehensively checks: (1) group 'developers' exists via 'getent group', (2) user 'dave' exists via 'id', (3) user is member of group via 'id -nG | grep', and (4) password is set (not locked/disabled) via /etc/shadow check.

llm_judge_reasons: Complete coverage: Evaluator verifies all 4 requirements from instruction
Group verification: 'getent group "developers"' correctly checks if group exists
User verification: 'id "dave"' explicitly checks if user exists
Group membership verification: 'id -nG "dave" | grep "developers"' correctly verifies user is member of group

Password verification: Shadow file check verifies password was set (not locked with '!' or disabled with '*'). While it cannot verify the EXACT password value 'Dev@Pass456' (impossible without interactive testing), it correctly verifies that a valid password was set and account is active
Metric logic correct: check_include_exclude properly checks all include patterns present and all exclude patterns absent
Expected values correct: Rules properly specify all 4 'YES' conditions must be present and all 4 'NO' conditions must be absent
